claims.text: Under the 2023 severely adverse scenario, the aggregate CET1 ratio of the 23 tested banks fell from an actual 12.4 percent at 2022:Q4 to a minimum of 9.9 percent, then rose to 10.5 percent at the end of the projection horizon, with aggregate and individual bank post-stress CET1 ratios remaining well above required minimums throughout.

citations.quotation: The aggregate and individual bank post-stress common equity tier 1 (CET1) capital ratios remain well above the required minimum levels throughout the projection horizon.
